environment.description: Same NestJS service deployed on ECS Fargate behind AppSync with a pipeline resolver configuration. The AppSync layer uses a request mapping template (VTL) that performs argument extraction and passes only resolved scalar values to the downstream Lambda data source which proxies to the ECS service. Additionally, the Aurora PostgreSQL instance has the pgaudit extension with pgaudit.log='all' and a CloudWatch Logs Insights scheduled query that triggers SNS on anomalous query patterns. The database connection uses IAM authentication with an RDS Proxy that enforces prepared statement protocol (extended query protocol only, simple query protocol disabled via the proxy's connection borrow timeout and init_query that sets plan_cache_mode=force_generic_plan). The HSM-backed signing ensures token integrity but the critical control is the RDS Proxy configuration with session pinning filters that reject any connection attempting to execute raw SQL strings longer than 256 characters or containing SQL comment sequences.

appsync.request_mapping: VTL scalar extraction - only passes validated field values

config.pgaudit: pgaudit.log = 'all', CloudWatch alerting on anomalous patterns
config.hsm: AWS CloudHSM cluster, PKCS#11 interface, keys non-extractable
